snapshot.title: Add M1-M4 new-user-flow tests and fix seed state issues
snapshot.description: Added run_new_user_flow_tests.gd (15 tests covering the complete Mission 1 new user journey) and run_later_missions_tests.gd (16 tests covering Missions 2-4 end-to-end). Fixed three test failures: (1) res://rockets_state.json seed file had stale developer state polluting fresh runs; (2) set_returned_mission stores label under 'label' key not 'target_label', and extra dict keys are merged at top level not nested under 'mission_data'; (3) badge format must use dash ('mission-1') not underscore to pass is_progress_badge_valid(). Also fixed _reset() to call save_state(clean) explicitly after reset_state() because RocketsManager.reset_state() called via GDScript preload/static does not execute its body in headless mode — known GDScript 4 quirk.
